03 / THE LONG VERSION

“I'll make it soon.”

I said that for long enough. Then I started shipping.

I'm a software engineering student who ended up deep in AI because I like systems with moving parts: retrieval, models, APIs, evaluation, deployment. The part I enjoy most is where the demo stops and engineering starts.

I care about clear answers, measurable results, and building things that another person can actually use.
